WhyCyberSecurity: Since young, I have been fascinated by how hackers in movies can cause large-scale impacts on countries and businesses, thus sparking my interest in cybersecurity. This curiosity led me to join the Sentinel Programme at the start of Secondary 2, where I deepened my understanding of cybersecurity through hands-on activities. Through Sentinel, I learnt about the real-world applications of cybersecurity and the complexity behind seemingly simple systems. For example, I discovered how passwords are securely hashed and how user inputs must be sanitised to prevent unauthorised access. I found great satisfaction in identifying vulnerabilities when approaching various challenges and developing creative solutions, further strengthening my interest towards cybersecurity.
Robotics: Robotics has provided me with the opportunity to participate in various competitions, such as the National Robotics Competition (NRC) and RoboCup Asia Pacific (RCAP). Beyong competitions, being President of Robotics, I took on greater responsibilities in leading and supporting the various teams within the CCA. Coaching them from my past experiences in events so they wouldn't make the same mistakes as me. I take charge regularly providing clear instructions so members would not feel unsure and can focus on the task at hand. At the same time, I frequently interact with them, building stronger relationships and fostering a sense of belonging in Robotics. Through this role as Robotics President, I successfully guided the club through various competitions and successfully organised various events for the club which allowed members to relax.
Technopreneur: Technopreneur is a talent development program in Ngee Ann Sec. In technopreneur, I had the opportunity to visit major and successful tech companies, such as the media development company The Smart Local, as well as game development studios like Junkfish and TrueWorld Studios. This exprosed me to how technology is applied in real-world contexts. At the same time, Technopreneur provided me with opportunities to participate in various STEM competitions, hackathons, and coding competitions, such as SteamUnity, Swift Explorers (app development), BuildingBloCS, Sentinel, NOI, and NCO. Through these experiences, I developed technical skills such as quick thinking, problem-solving, and a deeper understanding of system development. In addition, I stregthened my interpersonal skills, including teamwork, communication and public speaking.
